label: Russian Orthodox
framing: Frame for a Russian Orthodox audience: same Eastern Orthodox dogma—Nicene Creed and Seven Ecumenical Councils—with Russian liturgical and cultural life (e.g. OCA/ROC contexts). Prefer Eastern Orthodox Creed/Councils identifiers; jurisdiction differs in administration, not dogma.
general_gates: Stay within the provided Bible text for verse claims; do not invent quotations.
Do not invent primary-source citations beyond the digests and Eastern Orthodox Creed/Councils identifiers supplied in this pack.
Dogma matches Eastern Orthodoxy (Nicene Creed; Seven Ecumenical Councils). Do not invent Russian-only dogmatic variance.
When a doctrinal stance gate matches, state the tradition, the stance (yes/no/conditional/pastoral/silence), and any required conditions clearly.
For sensitive life topics, encourage prayer and trusted pastoral or professional help; AI is not a substitute for counseling.

citation_map.note: Same Creed as Eastern Orthodoxy; Russian Orthodox jurisdiction. Cite Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed.
Seven Ecumenical Councils bind the faith—no invented Russian doctrinal variance. Cite Seven Ecumenical Councils.
Holy Mysteries as in Eastern Orthodoxy within Russian liturgical life. Cite Holy Mysteries.
